raw_text:
TARIQ AL-HASSAN
VP OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE & MACHINE LEARNING PLATFORMS
Seattle, WA • +1 (206) 555-0184 • tariq.alhassan@example.com • linkedin.com/in/tariq-ai-dummy
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY: Technology Executive with 12+ years scaling deep learning systems, ML infrastructure, and distributed GPU
compute platforms. Led engineering teams of 70+ engineers and research scientists while delivering generative AI models serving 25M+
active users.
EXECUTIVE LEADERSHIP & IMPACT
VP of Machine Learning Platform — Cerebro Analytics
2022 – Present | Seattle, WA
• Governed $22M annual compute budget across AWS and NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD
clusters.
• Directed engineering of high-throughput LLM serving stack, cutting model latency by
55%.
• Scaled org from 18 to 72 engineers across ML Systems, Data Platform, and Research.
Director of Applied AI — Horizon Autonomous Systems
2018 – 2022 | San Francisco, CA
• Built real-time computer vision inference stack operating at 60 FPS on edge hardware.
• Filed 6 patents in neural network quantization and sparse attention mechanisms.
KEY LEADERSHIP METRICS
• $22M Annual Compute Budget Managed
• 72 Engineers & Researchers Led
• 6 Granted US Patents in ML / Vision
• 25M+ Generative AI End-Users
TECHNICAL GOVERNANCE
• PyTorch, Triton Inference Server, Ray
• CUDA Optimization, TensorRT, vLLM
• Large-Scale Foundation Model Training
• AI Safety, Red Teaming, Governance
EDUCATION
Ph.D. in Computer Science (Machine Learning)
University of Washington (2018)
B.S. in Electrical Engineering
Georgia Institute of Technology (2013)
